select * from (
SELECT T4.YIELD INVEST_RATE, T4.BASIS FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T2 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 ON T2.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and t2.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} WHERE T4.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 WHERE T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE > T4.EFF_DATE AND T3.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'))
UNION ALL SELECT T4.YIELD INVEST_RATE, T4.BASIS FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T2 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 ON T2.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and t2.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 WHERE T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE > T4.EFF_DATE) ) where LIMIT = 1

select * from(
select TPD.TRADE_ID bizCode, '01' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID,
TPD.CHL_ID chlId,
FPT.TYPE_6 projectType,
FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11,
FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, TPD.WORKFLOW_ID, TPD.WORKFLOW_STATUS status,
TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT
from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where TPD.IS_CANCEL != #{YES} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPD.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40})
UNION ALL
select TPD.TRADE_ID bizCode, '02' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID,
TPD.CHL_ID chlId,
FPT.TYPE_6 projectType,
FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11,
FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null status,
TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT
from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL != #{YES} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40})
UNION ALL
select TPD.TRADE_ID bizCode, '03' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID,
TPD.CHL_ID chlId,
FPT.TYPE_6 projectType,
FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11,
FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null status,
TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT
from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.P_TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40})
select TPD.TRADE_ID bizCode, '${statusValid}' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID,
TPD.CHL_ID chlId,
FPT.TYPE_6 projectType,
FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11,
FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK,
TPD.WORKFLOW_ID, TPD.WORKFLOW_STATUS status
null WORKFLOW_ID, null status
from
WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID
TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'
AND TPD.IS_CANCEL != #{YES} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03}
AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40})
) order by TRADE_DATE desc

select deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, '${statusValid}' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID,
TPD.CHL_ID chlId,
FPT.TYPE_6 projectType,
FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11,
FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, tpd.TRADE_AMT, DATE_FORMAT(tpd.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, tpd.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt, tpd.CPRICE_AMT, tpd.INT_AMT,
IFNULL(TTFD1.FEE_AMT,0) channelFee, IFNULL(TTFD.FEE_AMT, 0) commissionAmt, TTFD.FEE_RATE*100 commissionRate, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, deal.PAY_UNPAIDINT_AMT, deal.ISPAY_UNPAIDINT,
CASE TPD.SETTLE_SPEED WHEN 0 THEN #{01} ELSE #{02} END settleSpeed
from
WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID
TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TTFD ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TTFD.TRADE_ID AND TTFD.FEE_TYPE = '06' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TTFD1 ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TTFD1.TRADE_ID AND TTFD1.FEE_TYPE = #{FEE_TYPE_B09} where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

select * from(
select deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, '01' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID,
TPD.CHL_ID chlId,
FPT.TYPE_6 projectType,
FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11,
FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, TPD.WORKFLOW_ID, TPD.WORKFLOW_STATUS status, TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT from
WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where TPD.IS_CANCEL != #{YES} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPD.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40}) AND (DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL IS NULL OR DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL != 'Y')
UNION ALL
select deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, '02' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID, TPD.CHL_ID chlId, FPT.TYPE_6 projectType, FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null status, TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL != #{YES} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40}) AND (DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL IS NULL OR DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL != 'Y')
UNION ALL
select deal.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, '03' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID, TPD.CHL_ID chlId, FPT.TYPE_6 projectType, FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null status, TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.P_TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40}) AND (DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL IS NULL OR DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL != 'Y')
select deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, '${statusValid}' statusValid, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2, TPD.FINPROD_ID, TPD.CHL_ID chlId, FPT.TYPE_6 projectType, FPT.TYPE_9 type9, FPT.TYPE_10 type10, FPT.TYPE_11 type11, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, TPD.PS, TPD.PRIN_AMT, TPD.UNIT_CPRICE, TPD.UNIT_FPRICE, TPD.CCY, DATE_FORMAT(TPD.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, TPD.REMARK, TPD.TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT,
TPD.WORKFLOW_ID, TPD.WORKFLOW_STATUS status
null WORKFLOW_ID, null status
from
WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD left join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP on PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID
TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL deal left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and deal.PS=TPD.PS left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA on TPD.TRADE_ID=TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT FP on FP.FINPROD_ID = TPD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT on FP.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'
AND TPD.IS_CANCEL != #{YES} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03}
AND TPD.PS IN (#{T01}, #{T02}, #{T40}) AND (DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL IS NULL OR DEAL.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL != 'Y')
) order by TRADE_DATE desc
